attempts.summary: Created a systemd-managed service `inventory-worker` on node1 (AlmaLinux 9): runs as a dedicated system user, writes only to /var/lib/inventory, hardened with ProtectSystem=strict + ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory + NoNewPrivileges=true plus additional sandboxing directives. Verified confinement pre- and post-restart, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol (boot_id changed, service re-enabled/active, data preserved and appended after reboot).
